artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Rembrandt's National Gallery of Art panel sets Zeus and Hermes at the humble table of Philemon and Baucis — the old husband's hospitality rewarded in a glow of Dutch Golden Age light.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Jordaens fills the cottage with Flemish abundance as the disguised gods accept the old couple's meal — Philemon's poverty turned into festive welcome beside Baucis.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Elsheimer's small night scene places the gods inside a candlelit hut — Philemon and Baucis's kindness painted as intimate German Baroque drama.

popCulture.title: Baucis and Philemon
popCulture.description: Philemon beside Baucis endures as the faithful husband of the cottage — shared piety, shared metamorphosis into oak and linden.
